items.description: Modelo Especial is a premium Pilsner-style Mexican lager. Known for its light, golden hue and crisp, well-balanced taste, it features a subtle sweetness, mild hop character, and an orange blossom honey aroma.

items.name: New Holland Dragons Milks Stout 19.2oz can
items.description: Dragon's Milk is a popular, high-strength bourbon barrel-aged stout produced by New Holland Brewing Company in Holland, Michigan. Clocking in at a robust 11% ABV, it is widely recognized as the #1 selling American-made stout.

items.name: New Holland Peach Space Machine IPA 19.2oz can
items.description: Peach Space Machine is a year-round Hazy/Juicy IPA brewed by New Holland Brewing Company in Michigan. Clocking in at 6.8% ABV, it combines a heavy-handed blend of Citra and Galaxy hops with real fruit, creating a soft, pillowy, and tropical drinking experience.

items.name: New Holland Tangerine Space Machine IPA 19.2oz can
items.description: Tangerine Space Machine is a popular year-round Hazy IPA brewed by New Holland Brewing Company out of Holland, Michigan. Known for its juicy citrus profile, this sessionable craft beer features heavy tangerine notes balanced by Galaxy and Citra hops, resulting in a soft, smooth 6.8% ABV brew.

items.name: Prairie Rainbow Sherbert 19.2oz can
items.description: Prairie Rainbow Sherbet offers a delightful mix of fruity tart flavors in a colorful, refreshing treat.

items.name: Sapporo 22oz can
items.description: Sapporo is a Japanese beer known for its crisp, refreshing taste and light, smooth finish.

items.name: Sierra Nevada Pale Ale 19.2oz can
items.description: Sierra Nevada Pale Ale is a classic craft beer known for its smooth, hoppy flavor with a hint of citrus.

items.name: Stella Artois can 25oz can
items.description: Stella Artois is a premium European pale lager known for its distinct golden color, crisp carbonation, and smooth, refreshing taste. With an ABV of 5.0%, it offers an excellent balance of malt sweetness, bready flavors, and a dry, hoppy finish.

items.name: Stone Delicious IPA 19.2oz can
items.description: Stone Delicious IPA is a bright, intensely citrus-forward American IPA known for its lemon candy-like flavor and hop spice. Brewed to be gluten-reduced, this highly rated craft beer delivers a big hop punch while remaining crisp, dry, and highly drinkable.

items.name: Surfside Half & Half Vodka Iced Tea 19.2oz can
Truly Hard Seltzer Pineapple 24oz can
items.description: Truly Hard Seltzer Pineapple is a refreshing alcoholic beverage with a hint of pineapple flavor.

items.name: Truly Hard Seltzer Strawberry Lemonade 24oz can
items.description: Truly Strawberry Lemonade Hard Seltzer combines the sweet taste of strawberries with a tangy hint of lemonade.

items.name: Truly Hard Seltzer Wild Berry 24oz can
items.description: Truly Hard Seltzer Wild Berry is a refreshing hard seltzer with a blend of fruity berry flavors.

items.name: Twisted Tea Half & Half can 24oz can
items.description: Twisted Tea Half & Half is a refreshing blend of iced tea and lemonade with a hint of alcohol. Enjoy this 24oz can for a perfect mix of sweet and tangy flavor.

items.name: Voodoo Ranger Imperial IPA 19.2oz can
items.description: Voodoo Ranger Imperial IPA is a bold, high-alcohol India Pale Ale brewed by New Belgium Brewing. Featuring a robust 9% ABV. It blends pale and black malts with six hop varieties (Delta, Bravo, Centennial, Cascade, Calypso, and Mosaic) to deliver a heavy, resinous hop profile balanced by a rich, bready malt base.

items.name: Voodoo Ranger Juice Force IPA 19.2oz can
items.description: Voodoo Ranger Juice Force by New Belgium Brewing is a Hazy Imperial IPA that packs a massive tropical flavor punch and a high alcohol content, all while maintaining a remarkably smooth, highly drinkable finish.

items.name: White Claw Black Cherry 19.2oz can
items.description: White Claw Black Cherry is a refreshing hard seltzer with a hint of cherry flavor.

items.name: Yuengling 24oz can
items.description: Yuengling is a classic American lager that's been brewed since 1829, known for its rich amber color and smooth taste.

items.name: 12pk Blakes Fully Loaded Variety Pack cans
items.description: Blake's Fully Loaded Variety Pack includes 12 cans of unique and flavorful Ciders.

items.name: 4pk B. Nektar Zombie Killer cans
items.description: B. Nektar's Zombie Killer is a highly-rated, category-defying craft beverage that blends fermented apple cider, star thistle honey, and Michigan tart cherry juice. Clocking in at a sessionable 5.5% ABV, it delivers a crisp, tart, and subtly sweet flavor profile.

items.name: 4pk Mad Farmer Four Berry Pie Cider cans
items.description: Mad Farmer Four Berry Pie Cider is a 6.0% ABV semi-sweet hard cider brewed in Detroit, Michigan. It is crafted with cold-pressed apple juice and blended with blackberry, blueberry, raspberry, and Michigan Montmorency cherry juices for a sweet-tart, fruit-forward flavor profile.

items.name: 4pk Mad Farmer Peach Berrylicious Cider cans
items.description: Mad Farmer Peach-Berry-Licious is a fruit hard cider crafted in Detroit, Michigan. Blending cold-pressed apple juice with sweet peach and strawberry, it offers an aromatic, easy-drinking flavor profile with a 6% ABV.

items.name: 4pk Rekorderlig Mango Raspberry cans
items.description: Rekorderlig Mango Raspberry is a refreshing, fruity cider that combines the tropical sweetness of mango with the tartness of ripe raspberries.

items.name: 4pk Rekorderlig Wild Berry cans
items.description: Rekorderlig Wild Berries (often referred to for its luscious mix of wild blueberries and raspberries) is a premium Swedish hard cider. Blended with pure spring water, it delivers a crisp, sweet, and tart profile that is popularly served cold over ice.

items.name: 4pk St Ambrose Cherry Haze cans
items.description: St. Ambrose Cherry Haze is a smooth, juicy cyser (a blend of mead and hard apple cider) that bursts with bold Michigan cherry flavor, balanced by crisp apple and a touch of sweet honey.

items.name: 4pk St Ambrose Shotgun Wedding cans
items.description: St. Ambrose Shotgun Wedding is a gold-medal-winning draft mead (cyser) produced by St. Ambrose Cellars in Beulah, Michigan. It features a sweet and tart blend of honey, crisp apples, strawberries, and rhubarb, resulting in a refreshing, crisp beverage.

items.name: 4pk St Ambrose X R Cyser cans
items.description: St. Ambrose X.R. Cyser is an incredibly popular "apple pie in a can" This gluten-free 6% ABV session mead is a hybrid of half hard cider and half mead, blended with fermented Star Thistle honey, local apple cider, maple syrup, and cinnamon.

items.name: 4pk Tandem Ciders Clearly Conscience cans
items.description: Made from Ida Reds and seasonal blend of old-school apple varieties, this ethereal cider is extraordinarily clean and dry. Farmy yet fresh in the nose, crisp yet juicy in the mouth.

items.name: 4pk Tandem Ciders Smackintosh cans
items.description: Tandem Ciders' Smackintosh is a semi-sweet, highly refreshing hard cider produced in Suttons Bay, Michigan. Crafted primarily from a blend of McIntosh apples (alongside Rhode Island Greening and Northern Spy), it has an ABV of 4.5% and is celebrated for tasting incredibly close to biting into a fresh-picked apple.

items.name: 6pk Angry Orchard Hard Cider Crisp Apple btls
items.description: Angry Orchard Crisp Apple has a bright, crisp apple flavor, just like biting into a fresh apple. It is a perfect balance of sweetness and bright acidity from culinary apples and dryness of traditional cider making apples, resulting in a complex, yet refreshing, hard cider.

items.name: 6pk Blakes Hard Cider American Apple cans
items.description: Blake's American Apple is an imperial-style semi-sweet hard cider with 8% ABV, crafted by Blake's Hard Cider. It is made from 100% fresh-pressed American apples (including Jonathan, Ida Red, Honeycrisp, and Granny Smith varieties) and fermented with wine yeast to produce a clean, crisp finish.

items.name: 6pk Blakes Hard Cider Big Jam cans
items.description: Blake's Big Jam is an imperial-style, semi-sweet hard cider from Blake's Hard Cider. Acting as a turbo-charged version of their iconic Triple Jam, this dark red, fruit-forward brew blends apple, strawberry, blackberry, and raspberry with a punchy 8% ABV.

items.name: 6pk Blakes Hard Cider El Chavo cans
items.description: Blake's El Chavo is a uniquely sweet and spicy hard cider featuring a distinct blend of mango, homegrown habanero peppers, and Blake's classic Michigan apples. It delivers an authentic, fruit-forward profile balanced by a gentle, warm finish, and is 100% gluten-free.

items.name: 6pk Blakes Hard Cider Peach Party cans
items.description: Blake's Peach Party is a vibrant, fruit-forward hard cider crafted by Blake's Hard Cider Co. in Armada, Michigan. It offers a harmonious blend of sweet peaches, bold blackberries, and a crisp, fresh-pressed apple base.

items.name: 6pk Blakes Hard Cider Triple Jam cans
items.description: Blake's Triple Jam is a semi-sweet hard cider produced by Blake's Hard Cider Co. It is a refreshing, berry-forward blend made with 100% Michigan apple cider and real strawberries, blackberries, and raspberries. It features a 6.5% ABV, is gluten-free, and contains no artificial flavorings.

items.name: 6pk Starcut Ciders Pulsar cans
items.description: Starcut Ciders Pulsar is an award-winning, bone-dry hard cider crafted with Michigan apples and fermented with Pinot Noir wine yeast. It features a crisp, effervescent, and tangy flavor profile with subtle white wine aromas, and contains less than one gram of natural sugar per serving.

items.name: 6pk Vandermill Honeycrisp cans
items.description: Vander Mill Honeycrisp is a refreshingly smooth, semi-sweet hard cider crafted in Michigan using fresh-pressed Honeycrisp apple juice. It offers a clean, crisp apple flavor with a gentle sweetness up front that finishes surprisingly dry and is widely celebrated for its authentic fruit taste.

items.name: 6pk Vandermill Totally Roasted Cider cans
items.description: Vander Mill Totally Roasted is a popular craft hard cider featuring a sweet, dessert-like blend of Michigan apples, hand-roasted pecans, cinnamon, and whole vanilla beans. It balances a semi-sweet caramel and nutty profile with a tart finish, containing 6.5% ABV.

items.name: 12pk High Noon Beach Variety Pack cans
items.description: The High Noon Beach Variety Pack includes a selection of 12 refreshing hard seltzers in different fruit flavors. It's perfect for sharing with friends at the beach or enjoying on a sunny day.

items.name: 12pk Press Premium Seltzer Savor Variety Pack cans
items.description: The PRESS Savor (also known as Select) Variety Pack features a unique blend of sophisticated fruit and herbal hard seltzers. Each 12-pack typically contains 4.0% ABV and is gluten-removed, delivering a crisp, all-natural profile without being overly sweet.

items.name: 12pk Press Premium Seltzer Signature Variety Pack cans
items.description: The PRESS Premium Alcohol Seltzer Signature Variety Pack features culinary-inspired hard seltzers made with all-natural fruits and spices, crafted to remove gluten. This 12-pack (12 fl oz cans) contains 4.0% ABV, 110 calories, and 5g of sugar per can.
